title: Relational databases
brief: Understand shared relational facts, questions and guarded changes through one shop purchase. Distinguish schema rules, atomicity, concurrent decisions, query work and durability, judge relational fit and choose a practical next route.
ownership_note: Introduce enough of each concern to choose a route; children own detailed design, formal analysis and working procedures.

title: Sharding and distributed SQL
brief: Choose a distribution boundary from local work, invariant scope and the actual bottleneck. Distinguish replicas from shards, explain authoritative replicated history, acknowledgements and quorum availability, and separate agreement within one partition from atomic commit across partitions. Derive locality, skew, fan-out and coordination from the key.

neighbouring_ownership.placement: Owns latency and survival across failure domains.
neighbouring_ownership.replicas: Owns copied-history progress and read routing; distribution establishes quorum-based agreement within one replicated partition.

title: CockroachDB transactions and retries
brief: Relate intents and transaction state to atomic visibility, then handle native transaction retry and ambiguous-result paths for one logical purchase. Preserve the request identity and keep external work outside a replayed transaction.

neighbouring_ownership.transactions: Owns general invariant and isolation reasoning.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-reads: Owns current versus historical read choices.

title: CockroachDB isolation and follower reads
brief: Choose Serializable, Read Committed and historical reads from the decision they must support. Explain safe follower reads, freshness and retention limits without treating a historical observation as current authority.

title: CockroachDB query work and hot ranges
brief: Locate lookups, fan-out, SQL/KV work, network movement and contention from native evidence. Weigh covering and distributed keys against write and ordering costs, and separate less work from a hot-key bottleneck.

neighbouring_ownership.query-execution: Owns general execution operators and repairs.

title: CockroachDB table locality and region survival
brief: Choose regional-by-table, regional-by-row or GLOBAL tables and survival goals from actual access and failure requirements. Verify placement and survival, and distinguish structural reasoning from measured regional latency.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-operations: Owns native health and planned node removal.

title: Operating and securing a CockroachDB cluster
brief: Verify secure runtime identity, least privilege and tenant isolation. Use native evidence to diagnose under-replication and range health, then remove a node without consuming the cluster’s survival budget.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-performance: Owns expensive query and hot-key repairs.
neighbouring_ownership.cluster-change: Owns general movement and membership safety.

title: CockroachDB backup and recovery
brief: Validate full and incremental backup coverage and restore scope. Restore the intended history, close source writes, and reconcile a later valid booking by identity, capacity and external effects without consuming capacity twice.

neighbouring_ownership.backups: Owns general recovery and reconciliation method.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-migration: Owns a whole application write handover.

title: CockroachDB schema jobs under load
brief: Treat schema changes as observable jobs inside an application compatibility protocol. Interpret progress, failure and cleanup, and accept a backfill or unique index only after semantic checks.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-upgrades: Owns binary compatibility rather than application schema jobs.

title: Upgrading a CockroachDB cluster
brief: Rehearse binary rollout and the cluster-version boundary. Distinguish mixed binaries from finalised compatibility, and verify application acceptance, rollback eligibility and recovery choices.

neighbouring_ownership.cluster-change: Owns general redundancy and movement budgets.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-migration: Owns application transfer between database systems.

title: Moving a SQL application to CockroachDB
brief: Find semantic incompatibilities behind similar SQL, then port the application contract. Validate a consistent copy, transfer one write authority and reconcile a return path with explicit limits once new writes are accepted.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-backup: Owns native backup and restore scope.
